item.title: 18 Aug — Gibraltar’s prediction‑market door opens fast
item.description: **Gibraltar** - Gibraltar published its **Prediction Market Regulations 2026** (Legal Notice 176 of 2026) in the Gazette on **13 July 2026**; they came into force the same day, establishing the world’s first rules crafted specifically for prediction markets rather than wedged into betting laws ([company.gi](https://company.gi/blog/gibraltar-prediction-market-regulations-2026?utm_source=openai)). …
